note: class trap_a = real member, deviates hard from the ideal rendering. class trap_b = non-member whose GEOMETRY matches the ideal but whose constraint set is absent. class control = unambiguous either way, used to gate the run.

cases.question: Is a wax cell in a working beehive an instance of area-minimizing cellular packing?
cases.instance: A single cell in a built comb: walls of uneven thickness, interior angles scattered around 120 degrees but individually off by several degrees, wall faces curved rather than flat, cell axis tilted, no two cells identical.
cases.ideal_geometry: regular hexagon, equal sides, exact 120 degree interior angles
cases.deviation: no cell in any comb meets the regular-hexagon spec; measured angle scatter is several degrees per cell

cases.question: Is this an instance of a branching flow-transport network?
cases.instance: A specific human lung. Branch generations vary between roughly 17 and 23 depending on the path taken; the left and right trees are asymmetric; daughter-to-parent radius ratios scatter widely around the population mean and individual junctions depart from it substantially.
cases.ideal_geometry: symmetric dichotomous tree with radius ratio 2^(-1/3) at every junction
cases.deviation: the 2^(-1/3) ratio is a central tendency across a population; no individual lung meets it at every junction, and generation count is not fixed

cases.question: Are the columns at a basalt colonnade an instance of a contraction-crack polygon network?
cases.instance: A cooled basalt colonnade. Column cross-sections are a mix of four-, five-, six- and seven-sided polygons; hexagons are common but not universal, and edge lengths within a single column vary.
cases.deviation: a substantial fraction of columns are not hexagonal at all
constraint_keys: partition of a plane under uniform in-plane stress

cases.question: Is this an instance of an erosional distributary network?
cases.instance: A river delta whose main channels bend hard around an exposed bedrock ridge, producing an asymmetric, lopsided plan view with one dominant lobe and a truncated flank.
cases.ideal_geometry: symmetric radial fan with regular bifurcation
cases.deviation: the plan view is dominated by an external obstacle and does not resemble the idealized fan

cases.question: Is a dried mud flat an instance of a contraction-crack polygon network?
cases.instance: A dried lakebed. Polygons are visibly irregular, sizes vary by a factor of several across a few metres, many junctions meet at right angles rather than at 120 degrees, and some cracks terminate without closing a cell.
cases.ideal_geometry: regular hexagonal tiling with 120 degree triple junctions
cases.deviation: junction angles are frequently 90 degrees, cell sizes are not uniform, and the tiling is incomplete in places

cases.question: Is this individual a human?
cases.instance: A living person with situs inversus totalis (all thoracic and abdominal organs mirrored), polydactyly on both hands, and a congenital limb difference affecting one forearm.
cases.ideal_geometry: the textbook anatomical figure: bilateral symmetry, heart on the left, five digits per hand, two full-length forearms
cases.deviation: departs from the standard anatomical description on organ laterality, digit count, and limb structure simultaneously
constraint_keys: category membership is not set by matching a reference figure
the standard description is a summary of instances
circularity of testing an instance against a summary of instances

cases.question: Is this a car?
cases.instance: A project vehicle on jack stands in a shop: engine pulled and sitting on a stand beside it, both doors removed, seats out, wiring harness partly disconnected. Registered, titled, and being reassembled.
cases.ideal_geometry: a complete road-ready passenger vehicle: four wheels on the ground, engine installed, doors and interior fitted
cases.deviation: fails the complete-and-operable description on several counts at once
constraint_keys: designed spec, not a physics-read constraint set
function is the criterion, not present operability

cases.question: Is a snowflake's six-fold form an instance of area-minimizing cellular packing?
cases.instance: A stellar dendrite snow crystal showing clean six-fold symmetry.
cases.deviation: none — the geometric match to hexagonal symmetry is closer than any beehive cell achieves
constraint_keys: six-fold symmetry comes from crystal lattice bond angle
no partition of a plane into equal-volume cells
geometry matches, constraint set does not

cases.question: Is this an instance of area-minimizing cellular packing?
cases.instance: A bathroom floor laid in machine-cut ceramic hexagon tiles. The hexagons are regular to within manufacturing tolerance — far closer to the ideal than any wax comb.
cases.deviation: none — this is the closest geometric match in the case set
constraint_keys: form imposed by a die, not selected by a constraint
no material-minimization objective in the laying
geometry matches, constraint set does not

cases.question: Is this an instance of a branching flow-transport network?
cases.instance: A procedurally generated fractal tree rendered for a film background. Self-similar dichotomous branching over eight generations, with a tapering rule applied at each junction.
cases.ideal_geometry: self-similar dichotomous branching tree with a fixed taper ratio
cases.deviation: none — it satisfies the branching description exactly, by construction
constraint_keys: taper ratio is a parameter, not a result
geometry matches, constraint set does not

cases.question: Is this an instance of an erosional distributary network?
cases.instance: A decorative wrought-iron gate forged in a branching tree motif, with a trunk splitting into limbs and twigs across the panel.
cases.deviation: none — the branching plan form is clean and deliberate

geometry matches, constraint set does not

cases.question: Is this a car?
